applies_to: this successor preparation only, before outcomes

fit.supported: retain supported fine and no-fit-neighbor raw groups
fit.rare: merge only rare raw fine/no-neighbor groups within class; if class rare-only union remains unsupported, combine such unions into remaining-rare-only global fallback
fit.terminal_global: if remaining-rare-only global union is below32, stop; never overlap supported groups, drop targets or relax minimum

control.cells: complete global, every supported complete class, every supported fine/no-neighbor raw group
control.duplicates: deduplicate identical memberships in global then class then raw-group order; record aliases

optimizer.name: modified AdamW step: scaled full displacement with full proposed moment commitment
optimizer.accepted_nonzero: commit full proposed optimizer Python/moment/step state once and scaled complete parameter displacement including weight decay
optimizer.zero_or_rejection: bitwise-zero full/trial displacement or all rejected scales discards all parameter and optimizer/state changes; no extra zero guard under adopted interpretation

architecture_correction: Existing intermediate private factors were a prerequisite, not verified implementation availability. No verified all-layer PolyFormer port exists in inspected sources.
